anchors.statement: Shpherd's initial runtime workspace must be generated from sc-runtime version 0.1.1.
anchors.quote: install the sc-runtime templates at 0.1.1 (latest release)
anchors.context: Phase B sprint planning in Codex
anchors.scope: The first Phase B bead that installs or generates the Shpherd runtime workspace.
anchors.deterministic_check: Cargo metadata and the generation record identify sc-runtime 0.1.1 for the initial Shpherd scaffold.

anchors.statement: Template installation and testing must precede scmux feature and UI migration in Phase B.
anchors.quote: I would expect the plan to start w/ template installation and testing. Then have sprints to migrate the current scmux features and ui to shpherd.
anchors.context: Phase B sprint planning in Codex
anchors.scope: The dependency order among Phase B implementation beads.
anchors.deterministic_check: Every scmux migration bead depends transitively on the completed sc-runtime installation-and-test bead.

anchors.statement: The sc-runtime 0.2.0 upgrade must be the next Shpherd work started after version 0.2.0 is released.
anchors.quote: updrade to 0.2.0 as soon as it lands
anchors.context: Phase B sprint planning in Codex
anchors.scope: Phase B work started after the sc-runtime 0.2.0 release becomes available.
anchors.deterministic_check: The tracker history shows no new feature bead started between the sc-runtime 0.2.0 release and the Shpherd 0.2.0 upgrade bead.

anchors.statement: Shpherd's sc-runtime 0.2.0 upgrade must include the dependency updates supplied by that release.
anchors.quote: 0.2.0 upgrades some dependencies and fully installs sc-lint 0.8.4+ on consumer repo
anchors.context: Phase B sprint planning in Codex
anchors.scope: The Phase B bead that upgrades Shpherd from sc-runtime 0.1.1 to 0.2.0.
anchors.deterministic_check: Shpherd's dependency manifests match a fresh sc-runtime 0.2.0 generation for managed dependency versions.

anchors.statement: Shpherd's sc-runtime 0.2.0 upgrade must leave sc-lint 0.8.4 or newer fully installed in the consumer repository.
anchors.quote: 0.2.0 upgrades some dependencies and fully installs sc-lint 0.8.4+ on consumer repo
anchors.context: Phase B sprint planning in Codex
anchors.scope: The Phase B bead that upgrades Shpherd from sc-runtime 0.1.1 to 0.2.0.
anchors.deterministic_check: The consumer repository contains the complete sc-lint installation and its version check reports 0.8.4 or newer.

anchors.statement: Shpherd's initial database schema must be ported from scmux.
anchors.quote: use the existing schema + ui logic in scmux
anchors.context: Phase B sprint planning in Codex
anchors.scope: Every Phase B bead that creates or migrates Shpherd database schema objects.
anchors.deterministic_check: A schema parity test compares Shpherd migrations with the pinned scmux schema and explains every intentional difference.

anchors.statement: Shpherd's initial UI logic must be ported from scmux.
anchors.quote: use the existing schema + ui logic in scmux
anchors.context: Phase B sprint planning in Codex
anchors.scope: Every Phase B bead that creates or migrates dashboard or editor UI logic.
anchors.deterministic_check: UI parity tests map each retained scmux dashboard and editor behavior to a Shpherd implementation and test.

anchors.statement: Herdr must be Shpherd's default launcher.
anchors.quote: shpherd will be herdr first (by default)
anchors.context: Phase B sprint planning in Codex
anchors.scope: Any Phase B bead that defines or implements launch backend selection.
anchors.deterministic_check: A launcher selection test proves an unset launcher chooses Herdr.

anchors.quote: but will also support tmux launching (default in scmux).
anchors.context: Phase B sprint planning in Codex
anchors.scope: Any Phase B bead that defines team launcher configuration or implements tmux launch support.
anchors.deterministic_check: A launcher integration test proves an explicitly selected tmux backend can launch, observe, focus, and stop a team.

anchors.statement: Shpherd's initial database port must establish scmux schema parity before adding Herdr-specific fields.
anchors.quote: We may need to upgrade the scmux database schema i.e. add additional fields for herdr launching, but starting w/ parity is the goal.
anchors.context: Phase B sprint planning in Codex
anchors.scope: The database parity sprint and any later sprint adding Herdr-specific schema fields.
anchors.deterministic_check: The schema-parity commit and tests precede any migration that adds Herdr-specific columns or tables.
